channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: St. Lucie man with pancreatic cancer approved for experimental drug treatment
item.description: Russell Reed, 64, spent 62 days waiting to learn whether he would be approved to receive daraxonrasib, an experimental drug his oncologist believed could help after traditional treatments were no longer effective.

item.title: Jensen Beach Park restroom and concession rebuild set for late 2027
item.description: Beachgoers at Jensen Beach Park are waiting for the rebuild of the park's restrooms and concession building, which burned down on New Year's Eve in December 2024. The county says construction should begin in early 2027.

item.title: St. Lucie County pancreatic cancer patient approved for experimental treatment
item.description: Russell Reed, a 64-year-old St. Lucie man battling pancreatic cancer, has been approved to receive daraxonrasib, an experimental drug his oncologist believed could help after traditional treatments were no longer effective.

item.title: Jensen Beach Park restrooms and concession building rebuild expected by late 2027
item.description: Beachgoers at Jensen Beach Park are waiting for the rebuild of the park's restrooms and concession building, which was destroyed in a fire on New Year's Eve in December 2024.

item.title: 28-year-old man dies after weekend double shooting on South 14th Street in Fort Pierce
item.description: A 28-year-old man died Tuesday after he was shot multiple times in Fort Pierce early Sunday morning. A 28-year-old woman was also shot but sustained non-life-threatening injuries.

item.title: Martin County School District to cut 16 administrative positions, save nearly $4 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to eliminate 16 administrative and district-level positions, including three assistant principal positions, as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year.

item.title: Vero Beach homeowner faces $9,000 yearly insurance bill, may sell home
item.description: Kelly Hagen says her homeowners insurance jumped from $6,000 to $9,000 a year, forcing her to work two jobs and consider selling her Vero Beach home.

item.title: St. Lucie County Clerk website went down for hours after third-party redirect issue
item.description: The St. Lucie County Clerk and Comptroller's website was down for hours Tuesday, redirecting visitors to another site before coming back online by 1:30 p.m.

item.title: Fort Pierce owes nearly $16,000 in fines for unpermitted docks at Little Jim's
item.description: Florida Department of Environmental Protection claims Fort Pierce has been operating docks on state-owned submerged land at Little Jim Bait & Tackle without required permits since 2021.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup after 4-1 loss to Belgium in round of 16
item.description: Charles De Ketelaere scored twice and assisted on another goal as Belgium knocked the U.S. out of the World Cup for the second time in 12 years in a 4-1 defeat Monday night in Seattle.

item.title: IOC ending neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.title: FDA recalls frozen Publix GreenWise organic blueberries sold across Florida after E. coli contamination
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration has issued a recall for frozen Publix GreenWise Organic Blueberries due to possible E. coli contamination. The product was shipped to Publix retail stores throughout eight states, including Florida.

item.title: Florida households now need 17 months longer to save for home down payment than a decade ago
item.description: A new study by Smart Asset found that it now takes the median-income household earner in Florida 17 months longer to save up for a down payment in 2026 than in 2016. For Floridians earning minimum wage of $14 an hour, it takes nearly 26 years to save for a down payment.

item.title: Pennsylvania boy loses hand after alligator attack while fishing at Marion County fish camp
item.description: An 11-year-old Pennsylvania boy named Brodie lost his dominant right hand after an alligator attack two weekends ago at Nelson's Fish Camp near Umatilla in Marion County.

item.title: Vision Marine Technologies plans to sell Palm City property after consolidating operations
item.description: Vision Marine Technologies has completed consolidation of its tender-rigging operations at Fort Lauderdale Marina and announced a pending sale of its Palm City property.

item.title: 28-year-old man dies after weekend shooting on South 14th Street in Fort Pierce
item.description: A 28-year-old man died Tuesday from multiple gunshot wounds sustained early Sunday morning in Fort Pierce. Police say the shooting followed an earlier altercation on Okeechobee Road.

item.title: St. Lucie County Clerk's website down for hours Tuesday due to third-party service issue
item.description: The St. Lucie County Clerk and Comptroller's website was down for hours Tuesday, redirecting visitors to another site before coming back online around 1:30 p.m.

item.title: 66-year-old Fort Pierce man killed in Essex Drive shooting, suspect in custody
item.description: Andre Leonard Barnes, 66, of Fort Pierce, died Tuesday after being shot at a home in the 2700 block of Essex Drive.
